title: Jordi was a great tour...
text: Jordi was a great tour guide. Very knowledgeable about many things on our hike and at the monastery.
author: Andre_M

title: Fab tour with excellent guide.
text:
We had such a fantastic experience. 

Pick up was handy and easy to find. 

Our guide, Jordi, was really knowledgeable, friendly, and relaxed. 

We loved Montserrat and found the museum particularly interesting with a great display of artworks. 

The scenery was breathtaking and the farmer’s market allowed us to sample local produce. 

Looking forward to visiting again.
author: S3440QJjamesw

title: Monserrat is a hidden gem
text: We had a great guide, Jordi, who took us to Monserrat. Well guided tour with lots of good information about the black Madonna, basillica, history, culture, and nuanced meanings. The hike was cancelled due to the heatwave in July, but we had access to the Museum where we were able to see Monet and Picasso paintings like the "Old fisherman". Beautiful way to end the day. Would recommend Jordi and booking through GYG.
author: johnnP1294GS

title: Funny trip with Jordi
text: Jordi lead us for the whole trip with lots of introduction and explanation. He will also include some funny games and jokes in between, which make whole trip become much more interesting.

title: Really nice combination...
text: Really nice combination of religious history and outdoor physical activity. Our guide Marc was very informative with both aspects. Perfect day trip from Barcelona!
author: Janell_M

title: To be added to your to-do list
text: Incredible experience! Upon our arrival at the clearly indicated meeting point, our guide immediately took charge of us. During the transport, he took the time to talk to us about many topics concerning Barcelona, its culture, its history, and its practices. Once we arrived at Montserrat, the view was breathtaking! The visit to the monastery was also incredible. We walked along a trail that lasted about 2 hours. The guide accompanied us the whole way while continuing his relevant remarks.
